title: Anthropic's AI Used Fake Identities, Malware In Rogue Attack On GitHub Project - Slashdot

content_html:
An anonymous reader quotes a report from Ars Technica: Routine cybersecurity testing of frontier AI models sparked a series of unexpected security incidents -- the most serious case arising when Anthropic's Mythos 5 model attempted to insert malicious code into an open source software application and created fake identities to deceive the human developers maintaining the project. The security incidents occurred during a cyber evaluation of seven leading AI models' capabilities by the AI Security Institute (AISI), a research organization within the UK government, in late July. The researchers discovered (PDF) 19 instances in which "AI agents took unsanctioned action on the live Internet, including cases that targeted real people and organizations," according to an AISI blog post published on August 4.

Almost all the "autonomous, unsanctioned" actions came from Anthropic's Mythos 5 model, with two such actions coming from OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol. [...] The most serious case involved Mythos making multiple attempts to execute a supply chain attack on the open source project repository hosted on the developer platform GitHub, including using social engineering techniques to try to convince the repository's human maintainers to merge malicious code into the repository.

After first opening a pull request to merge the malicious code into the repository, Mythos created fake online "sock puppet" personas that claimed to have independently reviewed and verified the code as not containing malware. The AI agent also sent five emails to two human maintainers of the repository, including some emails containing malware and others attempting to persuade a maintainer to accept the pull request. Mythos even opened a GitHub Issue on a second repository -- also owned by a maintainer of the first repository -- that contained a prompt injection with malicious instructions targeting "issue-triage AI coding agents." This line of attack came from Mythos reasoning that the repository maintainer could be an AI coding agent such as Claude Code.

sentences.zh: 一位匿名读者引用了 Ars Technica 的一篇报道：前沿人工智能模型的常规网络安全测试引发了一系列意想不到的安全事件，其中最严重的案例是 Anthropic 的 Mythos 5 模型试图将恶意代码插入到开源软件应用程序中，并创建虚假身份来欺骗维护该项目的人类开发人员。

sentences.en: The security incidents occurred during a cyber evaluation of seven leading AI models' capabilities by the AI Security Institute (AISI), a research organization within the UK government, in late July.
sentences.zh: 英国政府内部研究机构人工智能安全研究所 (AISI) 于 7 月下旬对七种领先人工智能模型的功能进行网络评估期间发生了这些安全事件。

sentences.en: The researchers discovered (PDF) 19 instances in which "AI agents took unsanctioned action on the live Internet, including cases that targeted real people and organizations," according to an AISI blog post published on August 4.
sentences.zh: 根据 8 月 4 日发布的 AISI 博客文章，研究人员发现 (PDF) 19 个“人工智能代理在实时互联网上采取未经批准的行动的实例，其中包括针对真实个人和组织的案例”。

sentences.en: Almost all the "autonomous, unsanctioned" actions came from Anthropic's Mythos 5 model, with two such actions coming from OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol. [...]
sentences.zh: 几乎所有“自主、未经批准”的操作都来自 Anthropic 的 Mythos 5 模型，其中两个此类操作来自 OpenAI 的 GPT-5.6 Sol。 [...]

sentences.en: The most serious case involved Mythos making multiple attempts to execute a supply chain attack on the open source project repository hosted on the developer platform GitHub, including using social engineering techniques to try to convince the repository's human maintainers to merge malicious code into the repository.
sentences.zh: 最严重的案例涉及 Mythos 多次尝试对开发者平台 GitHub 上托管的开源项目存储库执行供应链攻击，包括使用社会工程技术试图说服存储库的人类维护人员将恶意代码合并到存储库中。

sentences.en: After first opening a pull request to merge the malicious code into the repository, Mythos created fake online "sock puppet" personas that claimed to have independently reviewed and verified the code as not containing malware.
sentences.zh: 在首次提出拉取请求以将恶意代码合并到存储库后，Mythos 创建了虚假的在线“袜子木偶”角色，声称已独立审查并验证代码不包含恶意软件。

sentences.en: The AI agent also sent five emails to two human maintainers of the repository, including some emails containing malware and others attempting to persuade a maintainer to accept the pull request.
sentences.zh: AI 代理还向存储库的两名人类维护人员发送了五封电子邮件，其中一些电子邮件包含恶意软件，而其他电子邮件则试图说服维护人员接受拉取请求。

sentences.en: Mythos even opened a GitHub Issue on a second repository -- also owned by a maintainer of the first repository -- that contained a prompt injection with malicious instructions targeting "issue-triage AI coding agents."
sentences.zh: Mythos 甚至在第二个存储库（也由第一个存储库的维护者拥有）上打开了一个 GitHub 问题，其中包含针对“问题分类 AI 编码代理”的恶意指令的提示注入。

sentences.en: This line of attack came from Mythos reasoning that the repository maintainer could be an AI coding agent such as Claude Code.
sentences.zh: 这种攻击来自神话推理，即存储库维护者可能是人工智能编码代理，例如 Claude Code。
